project_title: 景德镇：千年窑火，一瓷一世界（2×15s 端到端全自动制片版）
category: 城市文旅宣传片 · 2×15s 音画一体 + 自动后期母带
creative_concept: 专为 Google Flow (Veo) 端到端全自动制片流水线定制：将 30 秒大片拆为【上篇 15s：泥火成器】与【下篇 15s：器成天下】两段一镜到底长镜头。画面严守 100% 电影级纯净无字构图；采用【13.5s 台词安全截止线 + 末尾 1.5s 余韵留白】与【发音防错词 / 后期正字字幕双轨机制】彻底杜绝多音字误读与尾音截断；后期通过 Python (PIL) + ffmpeg 自动完成首尾留白微调、光斑叠化衔接、2.35:1 宽银幕遮幅、中英双语字幕压制及片尾『中国 · 景德镇』书法级落版大字合成。

review_status.review_notes: 已通过挑剔导演与技术总监双视角审查：1) 单镜无复杂多人穿模动作；2) 两段旁白均压缩在 32 字以内，确保 13.5s 前念完并留足 1.5s 光斑/航拍余韵；3) 易错词『千年重器/素坯』规避或同音注音，句末添加『……』防吞尾。

visual_bible.camera_and_lens: ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 Anamorphic Lens (35mm & 85mm Macro continuous zoom)
visual_bible.lighting_and_color: Warm amber kiln firelight (3200K) contrasting with Song Dynasty Qingbai jade-cyan shadows (6500K), Kodak Vision3 500T color science
visual_bible.texture_and_atmosphere: Subtle 35mm organic film grain, floating clay dust motes in volumetric Tyndall light beams, tactile wet clay and crystalline ceramic glaze reflections
visual_bible.style_suffix_en: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, continuous fluid gimbal movement, clean frame without text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no UI borders.

product_dna.subject_lock_en: museum-grade Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain vase (Qinghua Meiping), translucent ivory-white jade-like glaze, cobalt-blue hand-painted swirling cloud motifs, delicate golden ice-crackle glaze network
product_dna.materials_and_reflections: 半透明玉质感白釉底、深邃苏麻离青钴蓝晕染、高光处有细腻的冰裂纹玻璃态镜面反光
product_dna.ingredients_strategy: 两段 15s 均可直接通过云端 API / Google Flow 纯文生音画直出。若希望第 2 段中的青花梅瓶器型与纹样 100% 锁定，可将梅瓶参考图放入第 2 段 Ingredients。

audio_guide.voice_profile_zh: 央视纪录片级浑厚磁性男中音（《航拍中国》/《如果国宝会说话》旁白质感），标准普通话，语速沉稳克制，富有东方诗意与历史厚重感
audio_guide.voice_and_audio_lock_en: Audio & Voice Lock: Consistent warm, deep, magnetic male Mandarin Chinese documentary narrator voice (calm, poetic CCTV documentary cadence, studio condenser microphone clarity), accompanied by ethereal Guqin harmonics, tactile porcelain foley ASMR, and a building cinematic orchestral cello score.
audio_guide.bgm_style: 第1段（0-15s）：空灵古琴泛音配合湿润陶土旋转ASMR，第8秒窑火燃起时加入低沉大提琴独奏与火焰轰鸣，13.5-15s 人声收束仅留火光余韵；第2段（15-30s）：清脆瓷器冰裂开片声切入，恢弘东方交响乐与现代电子低频共振推向高潮，28.5-30s 以一声清越悠长的瓷鸣余音定格。
audio_guide.bgm_prompt_en: 30-second cinematic oriental luxury commercial soundtrack, first 15 seconds feature intimate tactile clay ASMR, ethereal Guqin harmonics, and building emotional cello with roaring fire; at 15 seconds a crystalline porcelain chime triggers an epic modern orchestral strings and deep sub-bass climax, ending at 30 seconds with a pure resonant porcelain ring, Wong Kar-wai meets Apple commercial score, 92 BPM.

shots.phase_name: 上篇：泥火成器 · 从指尖拉坯到千度窑变（13.5s 旁白收束 + 光斑过渡）

shots.gen_mode_reason: 聚焦『泥、笔、火』微观流体与光影演变；采用双轨配音词（把易错字『素坯』在发音轨注为同音字『素批』并加末尾『……』缓冲），13.5s 前结束旁白，留出 1.5s 纯净金色散景光斑过渡。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 【0-5s】暗室暖光下匠人双手旋转拉坯水珠飞溅 → 【5-10s】镜头推进衔接狼毫画笔在素坯上晕染钴蓝青花 → 【10-15s】烈焰包围瓷坯熔融出晶莹釉面，13.5-15s 化作满屏金色失焦光斑。
shots.visual_detail_zh:
• [00:00-00:05] 极近景俯拍，一束琥珀色丁达尔逆光刺破青色暗室，匠人苍劲的双手在高速旋转的拉坯机上塑出湿润的高岭土圆碗，细密水珠慢动作飞溅（配音：『一捧高岭土，在掌心苏醒』）；
• [00:05-00:10] 摄影机顺时针平滑下移并贴近素坯外壁，一支狼毫画笔蘸满深邃苏麻离青钴蓝料水落于素坯之上，蓝色水墨纹路在白色陶土肌理中自然晕染蔓延（配音：『落笔素坯上，藏山河方寸』）；
• [00:10-00:13.5] 镜头环绕推进，四周骤然燃起赤金色的千年柴窑烈焰，1300度高温下哑光陶土表面熔融化作晶莹剔透的液态玻璃白釉（配音在 13.5s 前收束：『千度烈焰里，淬炼温润……』）；
• [00:13.5-00:15] 静默余韵与转场留白：不再开口说话，镜头大光圈完全失焦（Rack focus out），漫天金色火星化作满屏温暖梦幻的圆形散景光斑（Golden Bokeh Orbs）。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 15s 一镜到底：俯拍旋转推入（0-5s）→ 顺滑下移贴外壁微距横移跟拍画笔（5-10s）→ 环绕推入火焰中心并于 13.5-15s 大光圈虚化失焦收尾
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 开篇首镜：黑场中一声清脆水滴声与古琴泛音，琥珀色侧逆光骤然点亮旋转的泥坯中心。
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 13.5s 旁白提前收束，画面在满屏温暖金色圆形光斑（Golden Bokeh）中结束，无缝叠化衔接第 2 段开头的清晨江面金色波光光斑。

shots.sfx_prompt_en: Wet clay spinning on potter wheel and water splashes transitioning into brush stroke on clay, then swelling into roaring kiln fire, crackling embers, and emotional cello
shots.flow_video_prompt_en: A continuous, unbroken 15-second cinematic macro camera journey through the birth of Jingdezhen porcelain with native Mandarin voiceover and synchronized foley sound design. [Visual & Camera]: From 0 to 5 seconds, an overhead close-up captures weathered artisan hands shaping wet spinning white clay on a potter's wheel as shimmering water droplets fly in slow motion. From 5 to 10 seconds, the camera smoothly spirals down to a macro side-profile as a fine calligraphy brush strokes deep cobalt-blue pigment onto the spinning clay, the blue ink blooming organically across the surface. From 10 to 13.5 seconds, roaring golden kiln flames erupt around the vessel, melting the matte clay into a glowing, translucent liquid-glass porcelain glaze. From 13.5 to 15 seconds, the lens racks completely out of focus, dissolving the golden fire and floating embers into fullscreen creamy circular golden bokeh light orbs as a transition hold. [Native Audio & SFX]: Synchronized high-fidelity ASMR sound of wet clay spinning and water droplets splashing (0-5s), soft calligraphy brush bristles stroking porous clay (5-10s), and deep roaring wood-kiln flames with crackling pine embers (10-15s), underscored by ethereal Guqin harmonics building into a deep emotional cello melody. [Voiceover]: Audio & Voice Lock: Consistent warm, deep, magnetic male Mandarin Chinese documentary narrator voice (calm, poetic CCTV documentary cadence, studio condenser microphone clarity), accompanied by ethereal Guqin harmonics, tactile porcelain foley ASMR, and a building cinematic orchestral cello score. The narrator speaks in standard Mandarin Chinese, finishing all speech cleanly before 13.5 seconds: "一捧高岭土，在掌心苏醒。落笔素批上，藏山河方寸。千度烈焰里，淬炼温润……" From 13.5 to 15 seconds, strictly no speech—only warm fire ambiance and cello resonance decay. [Global Visual Lock]: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, continuous fluid gimbal movement, clean frame without text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no UI borders.

• [00:25-00:28.2] 镜头顺着梅瓶浑圆的瓶口向上仰拍升起，无缝穿出景德镇御窑博物馆标志性的红砖双曲拱顶建筑，转为宏大的蓝调时刻（Blue Hour）无人机航拍向后拉升（配音收束：『窑火生生不息，中国景德镇……』）；
• [00:28.2-00:30] 落版呼吸留白：不再开口说话，温暖的红砖窑拱灯光对称倒映在镜面水池中，画面中央开阔纯净留白，伴随清越瓷鸣余音定格（后期脚本自动在此区间淡入『中国 · 景德镇』书法落版）。
